findings.title: Mailbox refspec relies on mailboxPrefix's trailing slash
findings.detail:
mailboxPrefix("*").replace(/\/$/, "") yields refs/norn/inbox/* only because mailboxPrefix ends in '/'; the comment explains it, so this is only a coupling note.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Leave as is, or add a small ids helper for the refspec pattern if more prefixes are added later.
